title: Demand for more stories set in the water

tellings.quote: he was saying in the second season you need to do more stuff in the water.

plain: Bryce Zable, a Hollywood writer behind the 1990s UFO television show Dark Skies, says that in 1996 a man he calls the captain came to the show's offices in Los Angeles. According to Zable, the captain told him that in the second season the show needed to do more stories set in the water, which he tells as a hint that someone wanted attention turned to UFOs in the oceans.
